title: ELSS Tax-Saving Mutual Funds: Lock-in & LTCG Taxation
source: SEBI & Finance Act Provisions (Income Tax Act 1961 & Income Tax Act 2025)
reference: Section 80C (recodified as Section 123 under Income Tax Act 2025) & Capital Gains Tax
content: ELSS (Equity Linked Savings Scheme) features: 1. Lock-in Period: 3 years per tranche (each SIP installment has an independent 3-year lock-in). 2. Tax Deduction: Contributions up to ₹1,50,000 eligible under Section 80C (recodified as Section 123 under Income Tax Act 2025). 3. Capital Gains Tax: Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) above ₹1.25 Lakh per financial year are taxed at 12.5% (without indexation). Shortest lock-in among all 80C investments.
